items.exampleEn: Her career spanned more than thirty years.
items.exampleZh: 她的職業生涯跨越三十多年。

items.exampleEn: A cube has six sides that are all the same size.
items.exampleZh: 立方體有六個大小完全相同的面。

items.exampleEn: The room was not sufficiently warm for the guests.
items.exampleZh: 這個房間對客人來說不夠暖。

items.exampleEn: My son has a shelf full of miniature cars.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子有一整個架子的迷你汽車模型。

items.exampleEn: Don't be overly worried about the test.
Make sure you are adequately prepared for the interview.
items.exampleZh: 務必為面試做好充分的準備。

items.exampleEn: If you multiply four by five, you get twenty.
The two plans are broadly similar.

items.sentenceEn: The bridge spans the river and connects the two towns.
items.sentenceZh: 這座橋跨越河流，連接兩個城鎮。

items.audioEn: The show has miniature houses, and each one is smaller than my hand.
items.audioZh: 這個展覽有迷你房子，每一棟都比我的手還小。

items.sentenceEn: Our costs have multiplied since we opened the second shop.
items.sentenceZh: 自從開了第二家店，我們的成本成倍增加。

items.sentenceEn: The workers were not adequately trained to use the new machine.
items.sentenceZh: 工人們沒有受過足夠的訓練來操作新機器。

items.stemEn: The report was ____ long; it could easily be half its length.
items.stemZh: 這份報告太長了；篇幅砍一半也沒問題。

items.stemEn: The storage room is a perfect ____: three meters long, wide, and high.
items.stemZh: 儲藏室是個完美的立方體：長、寬、高都是三公尺。

items.passageEn: My uncle has built a miniature model of our hometown. It spans an entire table in his garage, and every house is a small wooden cube with a painted roof. He started the project ten years ago, and the number of buildings has grown every year. Broadly speaking, the model is accurate, and many details are copied precisely, although some streets are overly narrow. He says the hardest part was the lighting: at first, the houses were not sufficiently bright, so he added tiny lights. Now the whole town is adequately lit, and visitors love to see it at night.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔做了一座我們家鄉的迷你模型。模型佔滿他車庫裡的一整張桌子，每棟房子都是一個屋頂上了漆的小木頭方塊。他十年前開始做這個作品，建築物的數量每年都在增加。大致來說，模型非常精確，許多細節都精準地複製出來，只是有些街道做得太窄了。他說最難的是燈光：一開始房子不夠亮，所以他加裝了小燈。現在整座小鎮都有足夠的照明，訪客很喜歡在晚上來看。

questions.questionZh: 叔叔什麼時候開始做這個模型？
一開始燈光有什麼問題？

items.promptZh: 大致來說，顧客對我們的服務很滿意。
referenceEn: Broadly speaking, customers are happy with our service.
Broadly speaking, our customers are satisfied with our service.
rubricZh: broadly 表示「大致來說」，例如放在句首的 broadly speaking 等
「對…很滿意」可寫，例如 be happy with、be satisfied with 等

referenceEn: The dishes at this restaurant are overly salty.
The food at this restaurant is overly salty.
rubricZh: overly 放在形容詞前，表示「過度地」（例如 overly salty 等）
「菜」可寫，例如 the dishes、the food 等；動詞配合主詞即可
